svg.title: How Tierwise routes a task: classify, rate the risk, plan, build, verify, review, and the debugging ladder
svg.text: Your main session stays on Opus. Every other step goes to an agent with a pinned model and effort.
Rules read the prompt and the files it names: question · trivial edit · local fix · feature · bulk ·
investigation · high-risk. A model is asked only when the rules are unsure.
from the paths and words in the prompt; it can rise during a task, never fall
A scout looks things up; the main
The main session edits directly, test first;
local fixes find the root cause before changing code.
At R2 and above the plan is reviewed.
high-risk core logic never below Opus.
Syntax · secret scan · your tests · type checks;
static analysis at R2+, threat model at R3.
Fresh-context reviewers see the diff and the spec, never the author's reasoning.
climbs only when the same failure repeats
Stop and ask you, with the diagnosis
the right model and effort · Haiku never judges · nothing below Opus at R3 · caps on Fable escalations · a per-task budget
